method: Entire embedded v17 module in Node VM with DOM/WebGL/audio adapters; actual game state, physics and combat functions.
checks: Entire generated module initializes with DOM, media and graphics adapters
All ten catalog entries are cleaned; all aircraft generate one player + four allied AI vs five enemy AI, with independent ammunition and BR ±1.0
6 km square bounds and opposite diagonal bases contain every initial aircraft; headings and velocities point toward A
A needs exactly 15 seconds from neutral and 30 from the enemy; objective and scores agree at 30/60/120 fps
A uses a true 300 m 3D sphere including its boundary; ties/empty/dead units never advance occupation
Own base restores 10% maximum health/ammunition per second with fractional ammunition accounting; enemy bases and dead units cannot replenish
Allied AI and enemy AI spend their own ammo; projectiles ignore friendlies and hit the first hostile along a swept path
Player death preserves the match with no respawn; observation switches/live target fallback work; dead player cannot fire and pause/resume cannot revive them
Boundary death enters spectating; team elimination, 100-point victory and simultaneous elimination finish correctly; restart creates a clean roster
The original campaign still starts its three bombers and five escorts and runs its own animation
